verses.sloka: स रथं सारथिर्हृष्टः परसैन्यप्रधर्षणम् ।गन्धर्वनगराकारं समुच्छ्रितपताकिनम् ।। ६.१०८.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa rathaṁ sārathirhṛṣṭaḥ parasainyapradharṣaṇam ।gandharvanagarākāraṁ samucchritapatākinam ।। 6.108.1 ।।

translations.english: Delighted charioteer drove the chariot of Ravana with speed. It was of the shape of the abode of Gandharvas, capable of destroying enemy's army. It had rows of excellent flags, richly endowed, like the best piece of artwork. It was fixed with flag posts in rows touching the sky and filling space. It was yoked to excellent horses adorned with gold chains and equipped with implements for war. The earth was resounding as it was driven as if to crush the enemy's army and its own army was happy.
translations.hindi: युद्धकाण्ड का सौवाँ 8 पूरा हुआ । —B— एकोत्तरशततमः सग; अ ९ 0 शल तस्मिन्‌ मतिहते$स्त्रे तु रावणो राक्षसाधिपः । क्रोधं च हिशुणं चक्रे क्रोधाचयाखमनन्तरम्‌

verses.sloka: युक्तं परमसम्पन्नैर्वाजिभिर्हेममालिभिः ।युद्धोपकरणैः पूर्णं पताकाध्वजमालिनम् ।। ६.१०८.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: yuktaṁ paramasampannairvājibhirhemamālibhiḥ ।yuddhopakaraṇaiḥ pūrṇaṁ patākādhvajamālinam ।। 6.108.2 ।।

translations.english: Delighted charioteer drove the chariot of Ravana with speed. It was of the shape of the abode of Gandharvas, capable of destroying enemy's army. It had rows of excellent flags, richly endowed, like the best piece of artwork. It was fixed with flag posts in rows touching the sky and filling space. It was yoked to excellent horses adorned with gold chains and equipped with implements for war. The earth was resounding as it was driven as if to crush the enemy's army and its own army was happy.

verses.sloka: ग्रसन्तमिव चाकाशं नादयन्तं वसुन्धराम् ।प्रणाशं परसैन्यानां स्वसैन्यानां प्रहर्षणम् ।रावणस्य रथं क्षिप्रं चोदयामास सारथिः ।। ६.१०८.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: grasantamiva cākāśaṁ nādayantaṁ vasundharām ।praṇāśaṁ parasainyānāṁ svasainyānāṁ praharṣaṇam ।rāvaṇasya rathaṁ kṣipraṁ codayāmāsa sārathiḥ ।। 6.108.3 ।।

translations.english: Delighted charioteer drove the chariot of Ravana with speed. It was of the shape of the abode of Gandharvas, capable of destroying enemy's army. It had rows of excellent flags, richly endowed, like the best piece of artwork. It was fixed with flag posts in rows touching the sky and filling space. It was yoked to excellent horses adorned with gold chains and equipped with implements for war. The earth was resounding as it was driven as if to crush the enemy's army and its own army was happy.

verses.sloka: तमापतन्तं सहसा स्वनवन्तं महास्वनम् ।रथं राक्षसराजस्य नरराजो ददर्श ह ।। ६.१०८.४ ।। ।कृष्णवाजिसमायुक्तं युक्तं रौद्रेण वर्चसा ।तडित्पताकागहनं दर्शितेन्द्रायुधायुधम् ।। ६.१०८.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tamāpatantaṁ sahasā svanavantaṁ mahāsvanam ।rathaṁ rākṣasarājasya nararājo dadarśa ha ।। 6.108.4 ।। ।kṛṣṇavājisamāyuktaṁ yuktaṁ raudreṇa varcasā ।taḍitpatākāgahanaṁ darśitendrāyudhāyudham ।। 6.108.5 ।।

translations.english: The chariot bells fixed to the huge flag post were making sounds, yoked to dark horses, and was shining with splendor with rage. It was glowing like a bright sun in the sky displaying its splendor, like the aerial chariot. It looked like a cloud holding water, releasing water of arrows from Rakshasa king's bow. The king of humans saw this chariot.
translations.hindi: फिर मुगूदर, कपटपाश तथा चमकते हुए वज्ञादि विविध तीइण शाख वैसे ही वेग से निकले ; जैसे वेग से प्रलयकालीन पवन 'यल्ता हं

verses.sloka: शरधारा विमुञ्चन्तं धारासारमिवाम्बुदम् ।तं दृष्ट्वा मेघसङ्काशमापतन्तं रथं रिपोः ।। ६.१०८.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: śaradhārā vimuñcantaṁ dhārāsāramivāmbudam ।taṁ dṛṣṭvā meghasaṅkāśamāpatantaṁ rathaṁ ripoḥ ।। 6.108.6 ।।

translations.english: The chariot bells fixed to the huge flag post were making sounds, yoked to dark horses, and was shining with splendor with rage. It was glowing like a bright sun in the sky displaying its splendor, like the aerial chariot. It looked like a cloud holding water, releasing water of arrows from Rakshasa king's bow. The king of humans saw this chariot.

verses.sloka: गिरैर्वज्राभिमृष्टस्य दीर्यतः सदृशस्वनम् ।विस्फारयन् वै वेगेन बालचन्द्रनतं धनुः ।। ६.१०८.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: girairvajrābhimṛṣṭasya dīryataḥ sadṛśasvanam ।visphārayan vai vegena bālacandranataṁ dhanuḥ ।। 6.108.7 ।।

translations.english: The chariot bells fixed to the huge flag post were making sounds, yoked to dark horses, and was shining with splendor with rage. It was glowing like a bright sun in the sky displaying its splendor, like the aerial chariot. It looked like a cloud holding water, releasing water of arrows from Rakshasa king's bow. The king of humans saw this chariot.
translations.hindi: उन चमचमाते चक्रां से सारा आकाश बेसे ही प्रकाशित हो गया ; जैसे गिरते हुए सूय चन्द्रादि ग्रहों से समस्त दिशाएँ प्रकाशित हो जाती हैं \८॥ तानि चिच्छेर बाणोधेश्वक्राणि स त राघव! । आयुधानि च चित्राणि रावणस्य चमूमुखे

verses.sloka: उवाच मातलिं रामः सहस्राक्षस्य सारथिम् ।। ६.१०८.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: uvāca mātaliṁ rāmaḥ sahasrākṣasya sārathim ।। 6.108.8 ।।

translations.english: The flow of arrows (from Ravana) released from the chariot were seen by Rama like the flow of water from rain clouds. Seeing that, Sri Rama made terrific sounds by stretching his bow to crescent shape, and it was as if a mountain struck by thunderbolt had broken and resounding and seeing Matali, charioteer of Indra, Sri Rama spoke as follows.

verses.sloka: मातले पश्य संरब्धमापतन्तं रथं रिपोः ।। ६.१०८.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: mātale paśya saṁrabdhamāpatantaṁ rathaṁ ripoḥ ।। 6.108.9 ।।

translations.english: The flow of arrows (from Ravana) released from the chariot were seen by Rama like the flow of water from rain clouds. Seeing that, Sri Rama made terrific sounds by stretching his bow to crescent shape, and it was as if a mountain struck by thunderbolt had broken and resounding and seeing Matali, charioteer of Indra, Sri Rama spoke as follows.

verses.sloka: यथा ऽ ऽपसव्यं पतता वेगेन महता पुनः ।समरे हन्तुमात्मानं तथा तेन कृता मतिः ।। ६.१०८.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: yathā ' 'pasavyaṁ patatā vegena mahatā punaḥ ।samare hantumātmānaṁ tathā tena kṛtā matiḥ ।। 6.108.10 ।।

translations.english: "Matali! the enemy's chariot is darting forward hurriedly. See him coming in the reverse direction with great speed once again. It strikes my mind that he is surely causing his fall."

verses.sloka: तदप्रमादमातिष्ठन् प्रत्युद्गच्छ रथं रिपोः ।विध्वंसयितुमिच्छामि वायुर्मेघमिवोत्थितम् ।। ६.१०८.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadapramādamātiṣṭhan pratyudgaccha rathaṁ ripoḥ ।vidhvaṁsayitumicchāmi vāyurmeghamivotthitam ।। 6.108.11 ।।

translations.english: "Matali! the enemy's chariot is darting forward hurriedly. See him coming in the reverse direction with great speed once again. It strikes my mind that he is surely causing his fall."

verses.sloka: अविक्लवमसम्भ्रान्तमव्यग्रहृदयेक्षणम् ।रश्मिसञ्चारनियतं प्रचोदय रथं द्रुतम् ।। ६.१०८.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: aviklavamasambhrāntamavyagrahṛdayekṣaṇam ।raśmisañcāraniyataṁ pracodaya rathaṁ drutam ।। 6.108.12 ।।

translations.english: "Being alert, you drive the chariot towards Ravana, just as wind drives the cloud in the sky, as I wish to destroy him."
translations.hindi: जब राक्षसराज रावण ने उप अज्ञ को भा व्य्थ जाते देखा. तब उसने दस बाण सार कर, श्रोराभ चर प्र जो के शरीर के समरत खमसस्‍्थलों को वेध डाला ॥। १८! स विद्धो दशभिर णेमेहाकामुंक निःसरते? । राबखेन महातेजा न प्राकम्पत रा घबः

verses.sloka: कामं न त्वं समाधेयः पुरन्दररथोचितः ।युयुत्सुरहमेकाग्रः स्मारये त्वां न शिक्षये ।। ६.१०८.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: kāmaṁ na tvaṁ samādheyaḥ purandararathocitaḥ ।yuyutsurahamekāgraḥ smāraye tvāṁ na śikṣaye ।। 6.108.13 ।।

translations.english: "Drive the chariot swiftly without confusion, without any agitation, with steady heart and vision, controlling the movement of reins and determination.

verses.sloka: परितुष्टः स रामस्य तेन वाक्येन मातलिः ।प्रचोदयामास रथं सुरसारथिसत्तमः ।। ६.१०८.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: parituṣṭaḥ sa rāmasya tena vākyena mātaliḥ ।pracodayāmāsa rathaṁ surasārathisattamaḥ ।। 6.108.14 ।।

translations.english: "You are a driver of great Indra's chariot. You are not required to be told. Wishing to fight with rapt attention, I will remind you now and then not instruct you", said Rama to Matali."
translations.hindi: समरविजयी श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने अत्यन्त क्रुद्ध हो बहुत से बाण मार कर, राउण के सारे शारीर को केद डाला ॥ १ शा] एतस्मिन्नन्तरे क्रद्धो राघवस्यानुजो बली । लक्ष्मणः मायकान सप्त जग्राह परवीरहा

verses.sloka: अपसव्यं ततः कुर्वन् रावणस्य महारथम् ।चक्रोत्क्षिप्तेन रजसा रावणं व्यवधानयत् ।। ६.१०८.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: apasavyaṁ tataḥ kurvan rāvaṇasya mahāratham ।cakrotkṣiptena rajasā rāvaṇaṁ vyavadhānayat ।। 6.108.15 ।।

translations.english: Matali, the best charioteer of the Devatas, was highly delighted at Rama's words and started driving.

verses.sloka: ततः क्रुद्धो दशग्रीवस्ताम्रविस्फारितेक्षणः ।रथप्रतिमुखं रामं सायकैरवधूनयत् ।। ६.१०८.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kruddho daśagrīvastāmravisphāritekṣaṇaḥ ।rathapratimukhaṁ rāmaṁ sāyakairavadhūnayat ।। 6.108.16 ।।

translations.english: Then Matali made the chariot turn round and by the dust rising from the rolling wheels of the chariot, Ravana was shaken.

verses.sloka: धर्षणामर्षितो रामो धैर्यं रोषेण लम्भयन् ।जग्राह सुमहावेगमैन्द्रं युधि शरासनम् ।शरांश्च सुमहातेजाः सूर्यरश्मिसमप्रभान् ।। ६.१०८.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: dharṣaṇāmarṣito rāmo dhairyaṁ roṣeṇa lambhayan ।jagrāha sumahāvegamaindraṁ yudhi śarāsanam ।śarāṁśca sumahātejāḥ sūryaraśmisamaprabhān ।। 6.108.17 ।।

translations.english: Then furious Ravana, the ten headed Rakshasa, whose eyes turned coppery in anger, struck Rama with arrows.
translations.hindi: तब मरे हुए घोडा के विशाल रथ से बड़ी फुर्वी से कूर कर फुत्तीले रावण ने आपने भाई विभीषण पर बड़ा क्रोध किआ || शा । ततः शक्ति महाशक्तिटीप्ता दीप्ताशनीमिव । बिभीषणाय चिक्षेप राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान

verses.sloka: तदोपोढं महद्युद्धमन्योन्यवधकाङ्क्षिणोः ।परस्पराभिमुखयोर्दृप्तयोरिव सिंहयोः ।। ६.१०८.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: tadopoḍhaṁ mahadyuddhamanyonyavadhakāṅkṣiṇoḥ ।parasparābhimukhayordṛptayoriva siṁhayoḥ ।। 6.108.18 ।।

translations.english: Rama who was provoked by the assault and army was perturbed. He took up Indra's bow of extraordinary impulse and of high speed like sunbeams.

verses.sloka: ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः ।समेयुर्द्वैरथं दृष्टुं रावणक्षयकाङ्क्षिणः ।। ६.१०८.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ ।sameyurdvairathaṁ dṛṣṭuṁ rāvaṇakṣayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ ।। 6.108.19 ।।

translations.english: The arrows endowed with very high speed, glowing in radiance like the sun's radiance, holding the arrows, each one desirous of killing the other stood facing each other, came near, and started fighting like lions in the great war.

verses.sloka: समुत्पेतुरथोत्पाता दारुणा रोमहर्षणाः ।रावणस्य विनाशाय राघवस्य जयाय च ।। ६.१०८.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: samutpeturathotpātā dāruṇā romaharṣaṇāḥ ।rāvaṇasya vināśāya rāghavasya jayāya ca ।। 6.108.20 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, the Gandharvas, Devas, Siddhas and sages longing for the end of Ravana came there to witness the duel.

verses.sloka: ववर्ष रुधिरं देवो रावणस्य रथोपरि ।वाता मण्डलिनस्तीक्ष्णा ह्यपसव्यं प्रचक्रमुः ।। ६.१०८.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: vavarṣa rudhiraṁ devo rāvaṇasya rathopari ।vātā maṇḍalinastīkṣṇā hyapasavyaṁ pracakramuḥ ।। 6.108.21 ।।

translations.english: Devas rained blood on Ravana's chariot, wind blew in circles intensely from left to right.
translations.hindi: क ranma उनका थक एको्तरशततमः सगे: १०६४ किन्तु उस वी को बीच हो में लक्ष्मण जी ने तीन बाण चला कर काट डाला । यह देख समरभूमि में वानरों ने बड़ा हषनाद किआ

verses.sloka: महद् गृध्रकुलं चास्य भ्रममाणं नभस्स्थले ।येन येन रथो याति तेन तेन प्रधावति ।। ६.१०८.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: mahad gṛdhrakulaṁ cāsya bhramamāṇaṁ nabhassthale ।yena yena ratho yāti tena tena pradhāvati ।। 6.108.22 ।।

translations.english: In the sky, a huge flock of eagles hovering on the chariot of Ravana went following the chariot wherever it went.
translations.hindi: सुबणंमाला से शोभित बह शक्ति चिनगारियाँ लिकालतीं ओर जलती हुई तीन टुकड़े हो बैसे ही गिरी ; जैसे आकाश से कोई बड़ा उल्का गिरे

verses.sloka: सन्ध्यया चावृता लङ्का जपापुष्पनिकाशया ।दृश्यते सम्प्रदीप्तेव दिवसे ऽपि वसुन्धरा ।। ६.१०८.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: sandhyayā cāvṛtā laṅkā japāpuṣpanikāśayā ।dṛśyate sampradīpteva divase 'pi vasundharā ।। 6.108.23 ।।

translations.english: Lanka seemed glowing in red colour like at dusk, and as though the earth was burning, shrouded with Japa flowers, even though it was daytime.
translations.hindi: तब तो रावण ने पुनः एक बड़ों भारी शक्ति (वर्छी ) ली । बह शक्ति चन्दनादि से पूजा की हुई थी ओर काल के लिए भो दुधेषं थी । वह अपनी चमक से चमक रही थी

verses.sloka: सनिर्घाता महोल्काश्च सम्प्रचेरुर्महास्वनाः ।विषादयंस्ते रक्षांसि रावणस्य तदा ऽहिताः ।। ६.१०८.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: sanirghātā maholkāśca sampracerurmahāsvanāḥ ।viṣādayaṁste rakṣāṁsi rāvaṇasya tadā 'hitāḥ ।। 6.108.24 ।।

translations.english: Meteors and huge fire dropped there indicating Ravana's end. Seeing them, Rakshasas were sad.
translations.hindi: महाबलबान एवं ढुरात्मा रावण ने बड़े ओर से उसे ( विभो- षण के ऊपर ) चलाना चाहा । वह शक्ति इष्द्र के शश्च के समान वमक रही थी

verses.sloka: रावणश्च यतस्तत्र सञ्चचाल वसुन्धरा ।रक्षसां च प्रहरतां गृहीता इव बाहवः ।। ६.१०८.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇaśca yatastatra sañcacāla vasundharā ।rakṣasāṁ ca praharatāṁ gṛhītā iva bāhavaḥ ।। 6.108.25 ।।

translations.english: Meteors and huge fire dropped there indicating Ravana's end. Seeing them, Rakshasas were sad.
translations.hindi: इतने में उस शक्ति द्वारा विभीषण के प्राण सङ्कट में देख, लक्ष्मण उनकी बचाने के लिए स्वयं विभीषण के सामने जा खड़े इए ( जिससे बिभीषण फे शक्ति न लगे) और धनुष पर बाण चढ़ा कर शक्ति लिए हुए रावण के ऊपर त्राणां की बर्षा करने लगे

verses.sloka: ताम्राः पीताः सिताश्वेताः पतिताः सूर्यरश्मयः ।दृश्यन्ते रावणस्याङ्गे पर्वतस्येव धातवः ।। ६.१०८.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tāmrāḥ pītāḥ sitāśvetāḥ patitāḥ sūryaraśmayaḥ ।dṛśyante rāvaṇasyāṅge parvatasyeva dhātavaḥ ।। 6.108.26 ।।

translations.english: Wherever Ravana went, the earth shook. Many Rakshasas felt their hands clasped.

verses.sloka: गृध्रैरनुगताश्चास्य वमन्त्यो ज्वलनं मुखैः ।प्रणेदुर्मुखमीक्षन्त्यः संरब्धमशिवं शिवाः ।। ६.१०८.२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: gṛdhrairanugatāścāsya vamantyo jvalanaṁ mukhaiḥ ।praṇedurmukhamīkṣantyaḥ saṁrabdhamaśivaṁ śivāḥ ।। 6.108.27 ।।

translations.english: The rays of the Sun fell in front of Ravana, in red, yellow, white, and dark like minerals on the mountain.

verses.sloka: प्रतिकूलं ववौ वायू रणे पांसून् समाकिरन् ।तस्य राक्षसराजस्य कुर्वन् दृष्टिविलोपनम् ।। ६.१०८.२८ ।।
verses.transliteration: pratikūlaṁ vavau vāyū raṇe pāṁsūn samākiran ।tasya rākṣasarājasya kurvan dṛṣṭivilopanam ।। 6.108.28 ।।

translations.english: The vultures followed by shejackals vomited, burning fire from their mouths indicating inauspiciousness and screamed.
translations.hindi: जब रावण ने देखा कि, लक्षमण ने बिभीषण को बचा लिया है, तब बह लक्ष्मण के सामने जा उनसे यह बोला

verses.sloka: निपेतुरिन्द्राशनयः सैन्ये चास्य समन्ततः ।दुर्विषह्यस्वना घोरा विना जलधरस्वनम् ।। ६.१०८.२९ ।।
verses.transliteration: nipeturindrāśanayaḥ sainye cāsya samantataḥ ।durviṣahyasvanā ghorā vinā jaladharasvanam ।। 6.108.29 ।।

translations.english: The unfavourable wind that blew in war, clouded the sight of Rakshasa king.
translations.hindi: हे सराहनीय बलशाली लक्षमण ! तूने इस शक्ति से बिभीषण को तो बचा दिआ अतएव में भी उसे छोड़ कर, अब इस शक्ति को तेरे ऊपर छोड़ता हूँ

verses.sloka: दिशश्च प्रदिशः सर्वा बभूवुस्तिमिरावृताः ।पांसुवर्षेण महता दुर्दर्शं च नभो ऽभवत् ।। ६.१०८.३० ।।
verses.transliteration: diśaśca pradiśaḥ sarvā babhūvustimirāvṛtāḥ ।pāṁsuvarṣeṇa mahatā durdarśaṁ ca nabho 'bhavat ।। 6.108.30 ।।

translations.english: Without clouds, terrific thunderbolts of Indra (rain) dropped on his (Ravana's) army all over causing unbearable sound.

verses.sloka: कुर्वन्त्यः कलहं घोरं शारिकास्तद्रथं प्रति ।निपेतुः शतशस्तत्र दारुणं दारुणारुताः ।। ६.१०८.३१ ।।
verses.transliteration: kurvantyaḥ kalahaṁ ghoraṁ śārikāstadrathaṁ prati ।nipetuḥ śataśastatra dāruṇaṁ dāruṇārutāḥ ।। 6.108.31 ।।

translations.english: All directions and intermediate points were enveloped by darkness by the shower of dust and the huge sky was obscure.
translations.hindi: मेरे हाथ से छूटी हुई यह रक्तांचह्वित ( खून से सनी हुई) शक्ति तेरे हृदय ( कलेजे ) को चीर कर, तेरे प्राण निकाल ले जायगी ॥|२६!! इस्येवश्ु कत्वा ता मष्टघए्टां महास्वनाम | मयेन सायाबिहिताममाघां शत्रघातिनीम्‌

verses.sloka: जघनेभ्यः स्फुलिङ्गांश्च नेत्रेभ्यो ऽश्रूणि सन्ततम् ।मुमुचुस्तस्य तुरगास्तुल्यमग्निं च वारि च ।। ६.१०८.३२ ।।
verses.transliteration: jaghanebhyaḥ sphuliṅgāṁśca netrebhyo 'śrūṇi santatam ।mumucustasya turagāstulyamagniṁ ca vāri ca ।। 6.108.32 ।।

translations.english: Hundreds of minas making frightening sounds, fighting in terrific manner emitting dreadful cries had fallen on the chariot there.

verses.sloka: एवम्प्रकारा बहवः समुत्पाता भयावहाः ।रावणस्य विनाशाय दारुणाः सम्प्रजज्ञिरे ।। ६.१०८.३३ ।।
verses.transliteration: evamprakārā bahavaḥ samutpātā bhayāvahāḥ ।rāvaṇasya vināśāya dāruṇāḥ samprajajñire ।। 6.108.33 ।।

translations.english: His (Ravana's) horses were letting out fire sparks from their hips, tears, water, and fire from their eyes at a time, continuously.
translations.hindi: भयंकर बेग से फेंकी हुईं और वज्र के समान संनसनाती वह शक्ति बड़े जोर से रणक्षेत्र में खड़े हुए लक्ष्मण के लगी

verses.sloka: रामस्यापि निमित्तानि सौम्यानि च शुभानि च ।बभूवुर्जयशंसीनि प्रादुर्भूतानि सर्वशः ।। ६.१०८.३४ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāmasyāpi nimittāni saumyāni ca śubhāni ca ।babhūvurjayaśaṁsīni prādurbhūtāni sarvaśaḥ ।। 6.108.34 ।।

translations.english: In that manner, many frightful and dreadful objects falling indicated destruction of Ravana.
translations.hindi: लोहितलखजा--रुधिरचिन्न | (बो०) |... बा० रा० यु०- ६ १०६८ युद्धकाण्डे उस समय उस शक्ति को लक्ष्मण जी के ऊपर गिरते देख श्रीरामचन्द्र जी बोले--लक्ष्मए का मङ्गल हो । यह शक्ति निष्फल आर हतोद्यम ( नष्टहननोद्योग ) हो जाय

verses.sloka: निमित्तानि च सौम्यानि राघवः स्वजयाय च ।दृष्ट्वा परमसंहृष्टो हतं मेने च रावणम् ।। ६.१०८.३५ ।।
verses.transliteration: nimittāni ca saumyāni rāghavaḥ svajayāya ca ।dṛṣṭvā paramasaṁhṛṣṭo hataṁ mene ca rāvaṇam ।। 6.108.35 ।।

translations.english: On all sides appeared indications of signs of victory for Rama, displaying beings delightful and auspicious.
translations.hindi: इस युद्ध में क्रुद्ध सर्प की तरह बह्‌ शक्ति छूट कर, शूरवीर और निर्भय खड़े हुए लक्षमण को छाती सें घुस गई

verses.sloka: ततो निरीक्ष्यात्मगतानि राघवो रणे निमित्तानि निमित्तकोविदः ।जगाम हर्षं च परां च निर्वृत्तिं चकार युद्धे ह्यधिकं च विक्रमम् ।। ६.१०८.३६ ।।
verses.transliteration: tato nirīkṣyātmagatāni rāghavo raṇe nimittāni nimittakovidaḥ ।jagāma harṣaṁ ca parāṁ ca nirvṛttiṁ cakāra yuddhe hyadhikaṁ ca vikramam ।। 6.108.36 ।।

translations.english: Sri Rama was very delighted over the appearance of good signs of his own victory and thought 'Ravana is destroyed by me'.
translations.hindi: सपेराज वासुकी की जिह्वा की तरह लपलपाती वह भयंकर शक्ति सहाकान्तिमान्‌ लच्मण के हृदय में घुस गई

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे अष्टोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। १०८ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe aṣṭottaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 108 ।।

translations.english: Raghava, skilled in the reading of omens, beholding those portents that appeared concerning himself upon the field, was filled with joy and deep content, and put forth still greater prowess in the fight.
translations.hindi: बहुत दूर से बलपूबेक फेकी हुई रावण की उस शक्ति के लगने से लक्ष्मण का हृदय ( कलेजा ) फट गया और बे प्रथिवी पर गिर पड़े
